messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: Dedicated tenant pool 'tenant-acme-corp' latency spike and queue saturation detected — page fired at 2026-03-14T02:00:34Z
PagerDuty: Page sent to rotation: eng-oncall -> Sam K
Sam K: ack, on it. grabbing metrics now
Mina R: ack. I can help if we need to scale or do fast failover.
Sam K: quick summary — p95 token latency jumped from ~120ms -> 1.8s, 5xx rate climbed to ~4.2% for tenant-acme-corp, request queue length > 1200 in the reserved pool.
Sam K: hitting the cluster control plane, checking reserved capacity and autoscale logs
Sam K: logs show reserved-pool-autoscaler attempted scale at 02:00:12 but failed with OOM provisioning error on node-template. suspicious
Mina R: running query against metrics (Datadog):
```promql
sum by (state) (inference_queue_length{tenant="tenant-acme-corp"})
```
Mina R: results: active queue ~1248, inflight tokens high, model variant serving is rwd-large-quantized-v2, CPU on host nodes 92%
Sam K: looks like reserved pool saturated and autoscaler couldn't get instances due to ephemeral quota/connector issue. Paging infra team?
Mina R: I'm swarming the tenant pool controller. Steps I'm planning:
- temporarily throttle new requests for tenant-acme-corp at the router
- enable fallback routing to hosted variant (hosted-small) for non-SLA critical requests
- attempt manual pool expansion (if infra allows)
Sam K: do the throttle first. patch router rule:
```bash
redwoodctl routes update --tenant tenant-acme-corp --rate-limit 20r/s --mode throttling
```
Mina R: applied the throttle rule, monitoring. :hourglass:
Sam K: enabling fallback to hosted variant for requests that include header X-Fallback-Allow: true
```bash
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --tenant tenant-acme-corp --fallback-model rwd-small-hosted --match-header X-Fallback-Allow
```
Mina R: fallback enabled. watch for drop in queue.
Sam K: queue length dropping from 1248 -> 430 -> 90 within 90s. p95 latency improving to ~220ms. 5xx down to 0.6%
Asha (oncall): great mitigation. any customer-visible errors still ongoing?
Mina R: ACME reported ~7 minutes of elevated errors; their SLA tier is dedicated-reserved. We should notify account and ops-legal that we routed some traffic to hosted fallback — this is a mitigation that may affect data locality.
Sam K: created incident doc stub: https://redwood-incidents.internal/INC-2026-0314-tenant-acme (will fill postmortem)
incident-bot: escalation to next layer in 15 minutes if not resolved.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Sam K at 2026-03-14T02:03:12Z
Mina R: trying manual pool resize now — provisioning API returned error: quota exceeded for region-us-west-2, looks like account-level limit. Contacting infra provisioning team.
Sam K: temporary cheat: increase worker concurrency per instance to absorb backlog. patch pool config:
```yaml
reserved_pool:
  tenant: tenant-acme-corp
  worker_concurrency: 48  # increased from 16
```
Mina R: rolled the worker_concurrency patch, new instances picked up config. queue drained fully by 02:07:10Z.
Sam K: confirmed user-visible metrics back to normal. p95 ~140ms, 5xx 0.1%. removing throttling and fallback gradually.
Mina R: removing routing fallback now and will keep throttling at a low level for 10m while infra confirms scale capacity.
Sam K: handoff to Asha for follow-up and RCA. Asha, summary:
- root cause: reserved pool saturation + autoscaler failed due to region quota error; provisioning blocked -> queue growth -> latency & 5xx
- mitigation: throttle at router, enable hosted fallback, increase worker_concurrency, attempted manual pool expansion (blocked), contacted infra provisioning team
- customer impact: tenant-acme-corp ~7 minutes of elevated errors and degraded latency, no data exfiltration; some requests served from hosted fallback (non-SLA traffic only).
- next actions: infra to resolve quota/provisioning, change autoscaler retry/backoff and alerting, add a paged runbook for 'quota provisioning failure', notify account execs and CS to inform ACME, schedule RCA within 48h.
Asha (oncall): taking handoff, thanks team. I'll open a follow-up ticket and assign infra/auto-scale owners.
Sam K: filing follow-ups:
- TICKET-7842: Investigate autoscaler failure and improve retry logic
- TICKET-7843: Increase region quota or add fallback region for reserved pools
- TICKET-7844: Add alert for autoscaler provisioning errors and surface to oncall immediately
Mina R: suggest we also add an alert that fires earlier for queue growth threshold at 300 to avoid hitting saturation.
Asha (oncall): adding that to TICKET-7844.
Sam K: thanks all. marking incident as resolved in PagerDuty.
PagerDuty: Incident resolved by Sam K at 2026-03-14T02:15:12Z
Mina R: :thumbsup: nice coordination.
Asha (oncall): I'll run the RCA draft tomorrow and ping infra and account teams. cc @CS-ACME
Sam K: leaving notes in the incident doc and linking graphs. good job. :tada:
